notes: Brief descriptions cover CPU instructions and common GNU assembler aliases, not the separate RSP vector instruction set.
Aliases/macros can expand to multiple machine instructions. Branch delay-slot behavior follows pre-Release-6 MIPS.
Unknown mnemonics deliberately get no guessed explanation.

sources.title: GNU binutils objdump: MIPS disassembler aliases

.word.description: Raw 32-bit data or an instruction the disassembler could not decode; not an instruction mnemonic.

abs.description: Compute an integer absolute value; an assembler macro that may need several instructions.

abs.d.description: Take the absolute value of a double-precision floating-point value.

abs.s.description: Take the absolute value of a single-precision floating-point value.

add.description: Add two 32-bit integers; signed overflow raises an exception.

addi.description: Add a sign-extended immediate to a 32-bit integer; signed overflow raises an exception.

addiu.description: Add a sign-extended immediate to a 32-bit integer without an overflow exception.

addu.description: Add two 32-bit integers without an overflow exception.

and.description: Compute the bitwise AND of two registers.

andi.description: Compute bitwise AND with a zero-extended 16-bit immediate.

b.description: Unconditionally branch to a nearby label after the delay slot; alias for beq zero, zero.

bal.description: Branch and save a return address; alias for bgezal zero. The next instruction is a delay slot.

bc1f.description: Branch if the FPU comparison condition is false; execute the delay slot either way.

bc1fl.description: Branch if the FPU comparison condition is false; execute the delay slot only if taken.

bc1t.description: Branch if the FPU comparison condition is true; execute the delay slot either way.

bc1tl.description: Branch if the FPU comparison condition is true; execute the delay slot only if taken.

beq.description: Branch if the two registers are equal. The next instruction is a delay slot executed either way.

beql.description: Branch if the two registers are equal. Execute the delay slot only when the branch is taken.

beqz.description: Branch if the register is zero; alias comparing against zero. The delay slot executes either way.

beqzl.description: Branch if the register is zero; alias comparing against zero. The delay slot executes only if taken.

bge.description: Branch when the first signed operand is greater than or equal to the second; assembler macro.

bgeu.description: Branch when the first unsigned operand is greater than or equal to the second; assembler macro.

bgez.description: Branch if the signed register is zero or positive. The next instruction is a delay slot executed either way.

bgezal.description: Branch if the signed register is zero or positive and set the return link register. The next instruction is a delay slot.

bgezall.description: Branch if the signed register is zero or positive and set the return link register. Execute the delay slot only if taken.

bgezl.description: Branch if the signed register is zero or positive. Execute the delay slot only when the branch is taken.

bgt.description: Branch when the first signed operand is greater than the second; assembler macro.

bgtu.description: Branch when the first unsigned operand is greater than the second; assembler macro.

bgtz.description: Branch if the signed register is positive. The next instruction is a delay slot executed either way.

bgtzl.description: Branch if the signed register is positive. Execute the delay slot only when the branch is taken.

ble.description: Branch when the first signed operand is less than or equal to the second; assembler macro.

bleu.description: Branch when the first unsigned operand is less than or equal to the second; assembler macro.

blez.description: Branch if the signed register is zero or negative. The next instruction is a delay slot executed either way.

blezl.description: Branch if the signed register is zero or negative. Execute the delay slot only when the branch is taken.

blt.description: Branch when the first signed operand is less than the second; assembler macro.

bltu.description: Branch when the first unsigned operand is less than the second; assembler macro.

bltz.description: Branch if the signed register is negative. The next instruction is a delay slot executed either way.

bltzal.description: Branch if the signed register is negative and set the return link register. The next instruction is a delay slot.

bltzall.description: Branch if the signed register is negative and set the return link register. Execute the delay slot only if taken.

bltzl.description: Branch if the signed register is negative. Execute the delay slot only when the branch is taken.

bne.description: Branch if the two registers differ. The next instruction is a delay slot executed either way.

bnel.description: Branch if the two registers differ. Execute the delay slot only when the branch is taken.

bnez.description: Branch if the register is nonzero; alias comparing against zero. The delay slot executes either way.

bnezl.description: Branch if the register is nonzero; alias comparing against zero. The delay slot executes only if taken.

c.eq.d.description: Compare double-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when equal.

c.eq.s.description: Compare single-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when equal.

c.f.d.description: Compare double-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when always false.

c.f.s.description: Compare single-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when always false.

c.le.d.description: Compare double-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when less than or equal. This signaling comparison raises invalid-operation for NaN operands.

c.le.s.description: Compare single-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when less than or equal. This signaling comparison raises invalid-operation for NaN operands.

c.lt.d.description: Compare double-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when less than. This signaling comparison raises invalid-operation for NaN operands.

c.lt.s.description: Compare single-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when less than. This signaling comparison raises invalid-operation for NaN operands.

c.nge.d.description: Compare double-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when unordered or less than. This signaling comparison raises invalid-operation for NaN operands.

c.nge.s.description: Compare single-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when unordered or less than. This signaling comparison raises invalid-operation for NaN operands.

c.ngl.d.description: Compare double-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when unordered or equal. This signaling comparison raises invalid-operation for NaN operands.

c.ngl.s.description: Compare single-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when unordered or equal. This signaling comparison raises invalid-operation for NaN operands.

c.ngle.d.description: Compare double-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when unordered. This signaling comparison raises invalid-operation for NaN operands.

c.ngle.s.description: Compare single-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when unordered. This signaling comparison raises invalid-operation for NaN operands.

c.ngt.d.description: Compare double-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when unordered or less than or equal. This signaling comparison raises invalid-operation for NaN operands.

c.ngt.s.description: Compare single-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when unordered or less than or equal. This signaling comparison raises invalid-operation for NaN operands.

c.ole.d.description: Compare double-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when ordered and less than or equal.

c.ole.s.description: Compare single-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when ordered and less than or equal.

c.olt.d.description: Compare double-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when ordered and less than.

c.olt.s.description: Compare single-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when ordered and less than.

c.seq.d.description: Compare double-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when equal. This signaling comparison raises invalid-operation for NaN operands.

c.seq.s.description: Compare single-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when equal. This signaling comparison raises invalid-operation for NaN operands.

c.sf.d.description: Compare double-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when always false. This signaling comparison raises invalid-operation for NaN operands.

c.sf.s.description: Compare single-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when always false. This signaling comparison raises invalid-operation for NaN operands.

c.ueq.d.description: Compare double-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when unordered or equal.

c.ueq.s.description: Compare single-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when unordered or equal.

c.ule.d.description: Compare double-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when unordered or less than or equal.

c.ule.s.description: Compare single-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when unordered or less than or equal.

c.ult.d.description: Compare double-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when unordered or less than.

c.ult.s.description: Compare single-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when unordered or less than.

c.un.d.description: Compare double-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when unordered (at least one operand is NaN).

c.un.s.description: Compare single-precision floats and set the FPU condition flag when unordered (at least one operand is NaN).

cache.description: Perform the cache operation selected by the operation field at the specified address.

ceil.l.d.description: Round toward positive infinity: convert a double-precision float to a signed 64-bit integer stored in an FPU register.

ceil.l.s.description: Round toward positive infinity: convert a single-precision float to a signed 64-bit integer stored in an FPU register.

ceil.w.d.description: Round toward positive infinity: convert a double-precision float to a signed 32-bit integer stored in an FPU register.

ceil.w.s.description: Round toward positive infinity: convert a single-precision float to a signed 32-bit integer stored in an FPU register.

cfc1.description: Copy an FPU control/status register to a general register.

clear.description: Set a register to zero; an assembler alias.

ctc1.description: Copy a general register into an FPU control/status register.

cvt.d.l.description: Convert a signed 64-bit integer held in an FPU register to a double-precision float.

cvt.d.s.description: Convert a single-precision float to double precision.

cvt.d.w.description: Convert a signed 32-bit integer held in an FPU register to a double-precision float.

cvt.l.d.description: Convert a double-precision float to a signed 64-bit integer in an FPU register, using the current FPU rounding mode.

cvt.l.s.description: Convert a single-precision float to a signed 64-bit integer in an FPU register, using the current FPU rounding mode.

cvt.s.d.description: Convert a double-precision float to single precision.

cvt.s.l.description: Convert a signed 64-bit integer held in an FPU register to a single-precision float.

cvt.s.w.description: Convert a signed 32-bit integer held in an FPU register to a single-precision float.

cvt.w.d.description: Convert a double-precision float to a signed 32-bit integer in an FPU register, using the current FPU rounding mode.

cvt.w.s.description: Convert a single-precision float to a signed 32-bit integer in an FPU register, using the current FPU rounding mode.

dabs.description: Compute an integer absolute value; an assembler macro that may need several instructions.

dadd.description: Add two 64-bit integers; signed overflow raises an exception.

daddi.description: Add a sign-extended immediate to a 64-bit integer; signed overflow raises an exception.

daddiu.description: Add a sign-extended immediate to a 64-bit integer without an overflow exception.

daddu.description: Add two 64-bit integers without an overflow exception.

ddiv.description: Divide signed 64-bit integers; LO receives the quotient and HI the remainder. Assembler macros may add safety checks.

ddivu.description: Divide unsigned 64-bit integers; LO receives the quotient and HI the remainder. Assembler macros may add safety checks.

div.description: Divide signed 32-bit integers; LO receives the quotient and HI the remainder. Assembler macros may add safety checks.

divu.description: Divide unsigned 32-bit integers; LO receives the quotient and HI the remainder. Assembler macros may add safety checks.

dla.description: Load a symbol address into a register; this assembler macro may expand into several instructions.

dli.description: Load an integer constant into a register; this assembler macro may expand into several instructions.

dmfc0.description: Copy 64 bits from a CP0 system register to a general register.

dmfc1.description: Copy 64 bits from an FPU data register to a general register.

dmtc0.description: Copy 64 bits from a general register to a CP0 system register.

dmtc1.description: Copy 64 bits from a general register to an FPU data register; this transfers bits without numeric conversion.

dmul.description: Multiply values and return the low product in a general register; on MIPS III this is an assembler macro.

dmult.description: Multiply two signed 64-bit integers; place the upper product in HI and lower product in LO.

dmultu.description: Multiply two unsigned 64-bit integers; place the upper product in HI and lower product in LO.

dmulu.description: Multiply values and return the low product in a general register; on MIPS III this is an assembler macro.

dneg.description: Negate a signed integer using subtraction from zero; overflow can raise an exception.

dnegu.description: Negate an integer without an overflow exception.

drem.description: Compute an integer remainder using division; the u forms use unsigned operands. Assembler macro.

dremu.description: Compute an integer remainder using division; the u forms use unsigned operands. Assembler macro.

drol.description: Rotate bits left or right; on MIPS III this is an assembler macro using shifts and logical operations.

dror.description: Rotate bits left or right; on MIPS III this is an assembler macro using shifts and logical operations.

dsll.description: Shift left, filling with zeros; use an immediate shift count on a 64-bit value.

dsll32.description: Shift left, filling with zeros on a 64-bit value by 32 plus the immediate count.

dsllv.description: Shift left, filling with zeros; take the shift count from a register for a 64-bit value.

dsra.description: Shift right, copying the sign bit; use an immediate shift count on a 64-bit value.

dsra32.description: Shift right, copying the sign bit on a 64-bit value by 32 plus the immediate count.

dsrav.description: Shift right, copying the sign bit; take the shift count from a register for a 64-bit value.

dsrl.description: Shift right, filling with zeros; use an immediate shift count on a 64-bit value.

dsrl32.description: Shift right, filling with zeros on a 64-bit value by 32 plus the immediate count.

dsrlv.description: Shift right, filling with zeros; take the shift count from a register for a 64-bit value.

dsub.description: Subtract 64-bit integers; signed overflow raises an exception.

dsubu.description: Subtract 64-bit integers without an overflow exception.

eret.description: Return from an exception using the exception return address; unlike ordinary jumps, has no delay slot.

floor.l.d.description: Round toward negative infinity: convert a double-precision float to a signed 64-bit integer stored in an FPU register.

floor.l.s.description: Round toward negative infinity: convert a single-precision float to a signed 64-bit integer stored in an FPU register.

floor.w.d.description: Round toward negative infinity: convert a double-precision float to a signed 32-bit integer stored in an FPU register.

floor.w.s.description: Round toward negative infinity: convert a single-precision float to a signed 32-bit integer stored in an FPU register.

j.description: Jump after the delay slot. Machine J encodes a destination in the current address region; the assembler's register form is an alias for JR.

jal.description: Call the encoded destination, saving PC + 8 in the return link register; execute the delay slot first.

jalr.description: Call an address held in a register, saving PC + 8 in the link register; execute the delay slot first.

jr.description: Jump to the address in a register after the delay slot; jr ra usually returns from a function.

l.d.description: Load 64 bits from memory into an FPU register. Assembler alias.

l.s.description: Load 32 bits from memory into an FPU register. Assembler alias.

la.description: Load a symbol address into a register; this assembler macro may expand into several instructions.

lb.description: Load one byte and sign-extend it at the base-register-plus-signed-offset memory address.

lbu.description: Load one byte and zero-extend it at the base-register-plus-signed-offset memory address.

ld.description: Load a 64-bit doubleword at the base-register-plus-signed-offset memory address.

ldc1.description: Load 64 bits from memory into an FPU register.

ldl.description: Merge bytes from memory into part of a 64-bit register value; paired loads can read an unaligned doubleword.

ldr.description: Merge bytes from memory into part of a 64-bit register value; paired loads can read an unaligned doubleword.

lh.description: Load a 16-bit halfword and sign-extend it at the base-register-plus-signed-offset memory address.

lhu.description: Load a 16-bit halfword and zero-extend it at the base-register-plus-signed-offset memory address.

li.description: Load an integer constant into a register; this assembler macro may expand into several instructions.

ll.description: Load a linked 32-bit word and start a reservation for a later conditional store.

lld.description: Load a linked 64-bit doubleword and start a reservation for a later conditional store.

lui.description: Load an immediate into bits 31–16 and clear bits 15–0; sign-extend the 32-bit result.

lw.description: Load a 32-bit word and sign-extend it at the base-register-plus-signed-offset memory address.

lwc1.description: Load 32 bits from memory into an FPU register.

lwl.description: Merge bytes from memory into part of a 32-bit register value; paired loads can read an unaligned word.

lwr.description: Merge bytes from memory into part of a 32-bit register value; paired loads can read an unaligned word.

lwu.description: Load a 32-bit word and zero-extend it at the base-register-plus-signed-offset memory address.

mfc0.description: Copy 32 bits from a CP0 system register to a general register.

mfc1.description: Copy 32 bits from an FPU data register to a general register.

mfhi.description: Copy the HI multiply/divide result register to a general register.

mflo.description: Copy the LO multiply/divide result register to a general register.

move.description: Copy one register to another; an alias for a suitable add or OR with the zero register.

mtc0.description: Copy 32 bits from a general register to a CP0 system register.

mtc1.description: Copy 32 bits from a general register to an FPU data register; this transfers bits without numeric conversion.

mthi.description: Copy a general register into HI.

mtlo.description: Copy a general register into LO.

mul.description: Multiply values and return the low product in a general register; on MIPS III this is an assembler macro.

mult.description: Multiply two signed 32-bit integers; place the upper product in HI and lower product in LO.

multu.description: Multiply two unsigned 32-bit integers; place the upper product in HI and lower product in LO.

mulu.description: Multiply values and return the low product in a general register; on MIPS III this is an assembler macro.

neg.description: Negate a signed integer using subtraction from zero; overflow can raise an exception.

negu.description: Negate an integer without an overflow exception.

nop.description: Do nothing. This is the assembler/disassembler alias for sll zero, zero, 0.

nor.description: Compute the bitwise NOR of two registers.

not.description: Invert all bits of a register; an alias for NOR with the zero register.

or.description: Compute the bitwise OR of two registers.

ori.description: Compute bitwise OR with a zero-extended 16-bit immediate.

rem.description: Compute an integer remainder using division; the u forms use unsigned operands. Assembler macro.

remu.description: Compute an integer remainder using division; the u forms use unsigned operands. Assembler macro.

rol.description: Rotate bits left or right; on MIPS III this is an assembler macro using shifts and logical operations.

ror.description: Rotate bits left or right; on MIPS III this is an assembler macro using shifts and logical operations.

round.l.d.description: Round to nearest, with ties to even: convert a double-precision float to a signed 64-bit integer stored in an FPU register.

round.l.s.description: Round to nearest, with ties to even: convert a single-precision float to a signed 64-bit integer stored in an FPU register.

round.w.d.description: Round to nearest, with ties to even: convert a double-precision float to a signed 32-bit integer stored in an FPU register.

round.w.s.description: Round to nearest, with ties to even: convert a single-precision float to a signed 32-bit integer stored in an FPU register.

s.d.description: Store 64 bits from an FPU register into memory. Assembler alias.

s.s.description: Store 32 bits from an FPU register into memory. Assembler alias.

sb.description: Store the low 8 bits of a register at the base-register-plus-signed-offset memory address.

sc.description: Attempt a conditional store after a linked load; replace the source register with 1 for success or 0 for failure. SC stores 32 bits; SCD stores 64 bits.

scd.description: Attempt a conditional store after a linked load; replace the source register with 1 for success or 0 for failure. SC stores 32 bits; SCD stores 64 bits.

sd.description: Store all 64 bits of a register at the base-register-plus-signed-offset memory address.

sdc1.description: Store 64 bits from an FPU register into memory.

sdl.description: Store part of a 64-bit register value; paired stores can write an unaligned doubleword.

sdr.description: Store part of a 64-bit register value; paired stores can write an unaligned doubleword.

seq.description: Produce 1 if the first operand is equal to the second, otherwise 0; assembler macro.

sge.description: Produce 1 if the first operand is greater than or equal to the second, otherwise 0; assembler macro.

sgeu.description: Unsigned comparison producing 1 if the first operand is greater than or equal to the second, otherwise 0; assembler macro.

sgt.description: Produce 1 if the first operand is greater than the second, otherwise 0; assembler macro.

sgtu.description: Unsigned comparison producing 1 if the first operand is greater than the second, otherwise 0; assembler macro.

sh.description: Store the low 16 bits of a register at the base-register-plus-signed-offset memory address.

sle.description: Produce 1 if the first operand is less than or equal to the second, otherwise 0; assembler macro.

sleu.description: Unsigned comparison producing 1 if the first operand is less than or equal to the second, otherwise 0; assembler macro.

sll.description: Shift left, filling with zeros; use an immediate shift count on a 32-bit value.

sllv.description: Shift left, filling with zeros; take the shift count from a register for a 32-bit value.

slt.description: Write 1 if the first register is less than the second using signed comparison; otherwise write 0.

slti.description: Compare a register with a sign-extended immediate as signed integers, producing 1 or 0.

sltiu.description: Compare a register with a sign-extended immediate as unsigned values, producing 1 or 0.

sltu.description: Write 1 if the first register is less than the second using unsigned comparison; otherwise write 0.

sne.description: Produce 1 if the first operand is not equal to the second, otherwise 0; assembler macro.

sqrt.d.description: Compute the square root of a double-precision floating-point value.

sqrt.s.description: Compute the square root of a single-precision floating-point value.

sra.description: Shift right, copying the sign bit; use an immediate shift count on a 32-bit value.

srav.description: Shift right, copying the sign bit; take the shift count from a register for a 32-bit value.

srl.description: Shift right, filling with zeros; use an immediate shift count on a 32-bit value.

srlv.description: Shift right, filling with zeros; take the shift count from a register for a 32-bit value.

sub.description: Subtract 32-bit integers; signed overflow raises an exception.

subu.description: Subtract 32-bit integers without an overflow exception.

sw.description: Store the low 32 bits of a register at the base-register-plus-signed-offset memory address.

swc1.description: Store 32 bits from an FPU register into memory.

swl.description: Store part of a 32-bit register value; paired stores can write an unaligned word.

swr.description: Store part of a 32-bit register value; paired stores can write an unaligned word.

sync.description: Order memory operations before and after this synchronization point.

teq.description: Raise a trap exception when two registers compare equal.

teqi.description: Raise a trap exception when a register and a sign-extended immediate compare equal.

tge.description: Raise a trap exception when two registers compare greater than or equal, signed.

tgei.description: Raise a trap exception when a register and a sign-extended immediate compare greater than or equal, signed.

tgeiu.description: Raise a trap exception when a register and a sign-extended immediate compare greater than or equal, unsigned.

tgeu.description: Raise a trap exception when two registers compare greater than or equal, unsigned.

tlbp.description: Probe the translation lookaside buffer for a matching entry.

tlbr.description: Read the indexed translation lookaside buffer entry into CP0 registers.

tlbwi.description: Write CP0 translation registers into the indexed TLB entry.

tlbwr.description: Write CP0 translation registers into a randomly selected TLB entry.

tlt.description: Raise a trap exception when two registers compare less than, signed.

tlti.description: Raise a trap exception when a register and a sign-extended immediate compare less than, signed.

tltiu.description: Raise a trap exception when a register and a sign-extended immediate compare less than, unsigned.

tltu.description: Raise a trap exception when two registers compare less than, unsigned.

tne.description: Raise a trap exception when two registers compare not equal.

tnei.description: Raise a trap exception when a register and a sign-extended immediate compare not equal.

trunc.l.d.description: Round toward zero: convert a double-precision float to a signed 64-bit integer stored in an FPU register.

trunc.l.s.description: Round toward zero: convert a single-precision float to a signed 64-bit integer stored in an FPU register.

trunc.w.d.description: Round toward zero: convert a double-precision float to a signed 32-bit integer stored in an FPU register.

trunc.w.s.description: Round toward zero: convert a single-precision float to a signed 32-bit integer stored in an FPU register.

uld.description: Load an unaligned 64-bit doubleword using an assembler macro.

ulh.description: Load an unaligned halfword with sign extension using an assembler macro.

ulhu.description: Load an unaligned halfword with zero extension using an assembler macro.

ulw.description: Load an unaligned 32-bit word using an assembler macro.

usd.description: Store an unaligned 64-bit doubleword using an assembler macro.

ush.description: Store an unaligned halfword using an assembler macro.

usw.description: Store an unaligned 32-bit word using an assembler macro.

xor.description: Compute the bitwise exclusive OR of two registers.

xori.description: Compute bitwise exclusive OR with a zero-extended 16-bit immediate.
